name: Totem Pole Photo Gallery
about_text: Totem Pole Photo Gallery is an artist-run photography space in Tokyo's Shinjuku ward, founded in 2008. It is operated collectively by twelve photographer-members who organize regular exhibitions of their own work alongside curated shows, events, workshops, and gallery rentals. Located on the first floor of the Dai-ni Fujikawa Building in Yotsuya, the gallery focuses on contemporary photographic practice, presenting a rotating program shaped by its member artists rather than a fixed roster of represented names outside the collective.

triage.site_notes: The site is essentially a chronological blog of individual exhibition posts (one per show, mostly untitled with dates), with only 'current' and 'upcoming' pages summarizing what's on now and a couple of tag pages ('exhibitions', 'past-2026') acting as thin archive indexes; there is no dedicated about, contact, or artist-roster page in the inventory, and per-artist or per-year archive listings likely exist as additional tag pages not captured here.
